name: pipe_to_intake
description: Thin pipe that turns a raw inbound profile (LinkedIn URL, pasted resume, free-text description) into a kanban candidate + dossier file in one synchronous call. Used by chat surfaces (Telegram, WhatsApp) so the agent only has to make ONE tool call to get a candidate onto the board. Parse + create logic is inlined here (mirrors parse_intake + create_candidate) because function-from-function chaining cold-starts each inner runtime and blows past the 120s API ceiling. triage_and_notify (founder email) is intentionally omitted — it depends on Gmail and is not worth blocking the chat surface on; surface a verdict-style reply after the candidate lands.
